name: Anyscale Hosted - A100
price_basis: per ACU-hour (Anyscale Compute Unit), on-demand, Hosted tier. Fetched 2026-10-04. 1 ACU is approximately 1 vCPU + 2GB RAM. The A100 instance includes the GPU plus its attached CPU/RAM. The exact ACU-to-instance mapping is not published, so the per-GPU-hour rate cannot be directly calculated.
notes: Anyscale A100 at $4.9591 ACU/hr is priced at a premium to raw cloud providers. The ACU model makes direct comparison difficult - if the A100 instance is ~82 ACU (10 vCPU + 144GB RAM), the per-GPU-hour rate would be ~$0.60, but this is speculative. Anyscale's value proposition is the Ray platform orchestration, not raw price competitiveness. H/B/GB families are all 'Contact Us'. $100 free credit for new accounts.
